claims.title: Acquiring operator laws with defects yields scoped corrected procedures

quoted_fields.failure: The law and defect calculus require the supplied exact fixed linear action/transpose interface and bounded grammar, rank and degree; noise, nonlinear or drifting maps, unacquired physical interfaces, an unsupported or non-unique candidate, or closure beyond budget do not receive a guarantee. The generic control excludes no higher-degree or higher-rank law. P x^2 P != (P x P)^2 blocks identifying the computational procedure with the separately projected physical function. A scalar-query lower bound does not transfer to this vector/transpose API; no universal total-cost win, retaining-method advantage, priority or physical capability is established.
